g.text: key store (root-only tree or state dir)
generate Ed25519 key, kid = ed_ + 16 hex of SHA-256(public)
1. Store(new private key) - atomic rename, fsync
2. INSERT signing_keys(kid, namespace, public_key) retired_at NULL
3. SetEdDSAKey: sign with the new key from here on
4. UPDATE retired_at = now + 15 min on the previous kid
token arrives with kid ed_new, not in cache
reloadOnMiss: SELECT signing_keys (at most 1 per second)
new key, previous key with retired_at
verify EdDSA; iss; key binds token namespace; revocation list; nbf, exp, iat, aud

text.tspan: after retired_at the previous kid is refused
